description: Worker w-MODU-001-0: Remove Legacy Migration Paths

tasks.title: Remove Legacy Migration Paths
tasks.description: Delete legacy plan/session migrations and template fallback logic to enforce hard cutover behavior.
acceptanceCriteria: No code in `src/run/run.ts` or `src/sessions/registry.ts` migrates legacy data or reads legacy fields.
Template lookup in `src/templates/engine.ts` no longer falls back to legacy agent paths.
Legacy migration tests are removed or updated to reflect the new behavior.

tasks.title: Move PRD Review Logic to Engine
tasks.description: Extract PRD revision prompt building, retries, and markdown extraction into a core engine module and make the TUI view-only.
acceptanceCriteria: `src/tui/PrdReviewView.tsx` no longer builds prompts or executes agents.
New engine module handles revision retries and markdown extraction with the same behavior.
Tests cover revision prompt creation and markdown extraction.

tasks.title: Platform Notifications and Update Target Interface
tasks.description: Move notifications and OS/arch detection behind `PlatformProvider` and implement per-platform behavior with non-fatal fallbacks.
acceptanceCriteria: Notifications are routed through platform implementations and failures surface as warnings without crashing.
Platform exposes a single OS/arch resolution method for updates, with unsupported platforms returning a clear error.
Notification tests validate the new platform-based API.
